research.name: lottie-react
research.note: React component and hook for Lottie animations, with scroll-scrubbed playback and a ready-made transport control bar.

effects: scroll-scrubbed Lottie playhead limited to a range band of the scroll
drop-in transport control bar with seek, frame readout, loop, direction, speed and fullscreen
